executionArgs.additionalInstruction: CRITICAL: Tests run in TestSprite cloud, NOT on the developer machine. Never open tests/fixtures/* paths. Import from ts_helpers (upload_fixture, upload_bytes, wait_indexed, stream_chat, auth_headers) and fixture_payloads.FIXTURES with base64 embedded bytes. Upload API returns source id in JSON field 'id' (not source_id). Indexed status is 'indexed'. Use dev JWT via ts_helpers.dev_jwt(). Keep existing patched tests in testsprite_tests/ when possible.
